relations.rationale: Comparing notes during breaks has no bearing on how many shifts the shop ran.
Noor and Kai comparing timing notes doesn't affect rankings involving Uma and Cy.
Comparing notes on timing between Noor and Kai has no logical connection to Fay's standing relative to Noor.
Comparing notes during breaks is unrelated to Kai reviewing final tally sheets after debates concluded, as these are separate activities.
The number of shifts a shop runs has no bearing on debate rankings.
The shop's shift schedule is unrelated to standings in a competition involving Fay and Noor.
The shop running three shifts has no connection to Kai reviewing tally sheets after a debate.
Rankings placing Uma above Cy don't directly determine Fay's position relative to Noor, as these involve different competitors.
Preliminary rankings between Uma and Cy don't directly relate to Kai's action of reviewing final tally sheets, though both pertain to a competition context.
Fay's standing relative to Noor is unrelated to Kai's act of reviewing tally sheets after the debate concluded.
